text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working ML engineer with 6 years of experience building practical NLP and machine learning solutions in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and general machine learning.

One relevant project was Product recommendations for Tidewater Outfitters, where I built similar-items and “you-may-also-like” carousels trained on 1.2M interactions and cached in Redis using Python, PyTorch, implicit, AWS SageMaker, and Redis. That work increased click-through rate by 14% in a 4-week A/B test.

For your lead disposition classification and prospect segmentation needs, I’d take a structured approach focused on model quality, clean feature engineering, and practical integration into your tool. I’d also be glad to discuss the NLP for A/B testing idea and help scope it.

Would you like me to start by mapping the 10 disposition labels into a model approach and evaluation plan?
